ransomware.title: Ransomware Containment & Triage Playbook
ransomware.description: Rapid response workflow to isolate active encryption threads, preserve volatile RAM, and identify persistence.

steps.title: 1. Host Containment & Network Isolation
steps.action: Isolate host from the network immediately without shutting down the OS to preserve volatile memory.
commands: netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state on
netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name="DFIR_BLOCK_ALL" dir=in action=block
netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name="DFIR_BLOCK_OUT" dir=out action=block

steps.title: 2. Volatile RAM Acquisition
steps.action: Capture unencrypted process memory and active C2 encryption keys before powering down or rebooting.

steps.title: 3. Identify Active Ransomware Execution
steps.action: Enumerate suspicious process handles, unusual execution paths, and high disk write activities.
commands: Get-Process | Where-Object {$_.Path -notlike "C:\Windows\*" -and $_.Path -notlike "C:\Program Files*"} | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, Path
Get-NetTCPConnection -State Established | Select-Object LocalAddress, LocalPort, RemoteAddress, RemotePort, OwningProcess

phishing.title: Phishing & Malicious Payload Analysis Playbook
phishing.description: Triage steps for email payload inspection, malicious macro detonation, and process tree analysis.

steps.title: 1. Extract Email Headers & Attachments
steps.action: Inspect Message-ID, Return-Path, DKIM/SPF alignment, and embedded URLs.

steps.title: 2. Inspect Child Process Spawn Hierarchy
steps.action: Look for office binaries (WINWORD.EXE, EXCEL.EXE) spawning cmd.exe, powershell.exe, or wscript.exe.
commands: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object {$_.ParentProcessId -ne $null} | Select-Object ProcessId, ParentProcessId, Name, CommandLine | Sort-Object ParentProcessId

network_exfil.title: Network Exfiltration & C2 Triage Playbook
network_exfil.description: Detect active tunneling, unauthorized outbound SMB/RDP connections, and DNS tunneling.

steps.title: 1. Inspect Socket Connections
steps.action: Cross-examine established TCP/UDP sockets with running binaries.
commands: Get-NetTCPConnection -State Established | Select-Object LocalAddress, LocalPort, RemoteAddress, RemotePort, OwningProcess, State

steps.title: 2. Check DNS Cache for Tunneling Indicators
steps.action: Inspect local client DNS resolution cache for high-entropy subdomain requests.
commands: Get-DnsClientCache | Select-Object Entry, Data, TimeToLive | Sort-Object Entry
